title: Langtang ice-rock avalanche, river-dam breach, debris flow & flash flood (cascade)
report_sources: Nepal NDRRMA (3 Sep 2026, 12:00); Nepal Police (3 Sep 2026, 10:00, reports 4,875 missing); USGS; UN OCHA; Onlinekhabar; Farsight Nepal; CNN, Aug-Sep 2026
notes: Cascading Himalayan hazard: several million m3 of ice and rock detached near 5,000 m above the Langtang area and fell ~1,900 m, blocking the Lhende river near the Nepal-China border and impounding a short-lived debris lake. The blockage failed and sent a debris flow and flash flood roughly 100 km down the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli, through Rasuwa into Nuwakot and Dhading, with cross-border impact at Gyirong in China. Nepal's deadliest disaster since the 2015 earthquake. Figures are provisional and still rising: 1,252 dead and 4,216 missing per NDRRMA at 12:00 on 3 Sep 2026 (Nepal Police separately reported 4,875 missing at 10:00 the same day, a different count method), up from 1,204/4,216 the day before and 489/1,500 a week earlier. China reported a further 16 dead and 546 missing in Tibet, not included in this Nepal-scoped record.
